title: Hurricane Florence – SC National Guard responds
description: This video combines the photographs and videos shot by South Carolina National Guard Public Affairs Soldiers and Airmen during the lead into and recovery efforts from Hurricane and Tropical Storm Florence, Sept. 10 - 27, 2018. Approximately 3,400 Soldiers and Airmen were mobilized over the course of two weeks to respond and participate in both rescue and recovery efforts as Hurricane and Tropical Storm Florence caused flooding and damage to the state. (U.S. Air National Guard Video by Master Sgt. Carl Clegg)
